_about: Annotated references for the benchmark clips, written by looking at the frames (contact sheets) and, for synthetic clips, at the script that drew them. Each fact matches when any of its patterns (case-insensitive regular expressions) appears in the finished track. allowedNumbers is given only where every number on screen is known (synthetic clips); speechWindows only where speech was measured independently of the app (clip 03, ffmpeg silencedetect).
